title: Qwen Office Launches the Industry's First Multi-User Workbench, Creating a Business Web Page Supporting Hundred-Person Collaboration with a Single Sentence
excerpt: On September 7, Alibaba Cloud Qwen Office launched the industry's first "Multi-User Workspace": users can describe their needs in natural language, and a web pa
content_html:
On September 7, Alibaba Cloud Qwen Office launched the industry's first "Multi-User Workspace": users can describe their needs in natural language, and a web page supporting up to 100 people collaborating online with a complete business process will be generated and published. This feature is designed for scenarios such as event organization, home-school collaboration, and enterprise collaboration, and is currently available directly through the function entry at the bottom of the Qwen Office homepage.

Different from AI workspaces on the market that focus on tools like online resumes, personal portfolios, and personal check-in devices, the Multi-User Workspace offers four core capabilities: role permissions, cloud database, management backend, and online publishing. It allows different data and operation permissions to be configured for roles such as administrators and regular members, unifies the accumulation of data, task status, and work progress submitted by members, and supports centralized management and statistics in the background. After the web page is created, it can be published with one click, and team members can access and use it via the link according to their permissions. When setting up, just clarify the roles, tasks, and data to be managed, and the system will automatically break down the execution. If the business process changes, it can also be modified through natural language.

In scenarios such as home-school collaboration, celebrity promotion, chain stores, and large-scale markets, leave approval, information collection, review, and progress tracking can all be carried out within one workspace. In the past, companies usually needed to purchase ERP, OA, or vertical industry SaaS to implement a business process software, which often took several months from requirement communication to development and launch. Generating multi-user collaborative business applications directly through natural language provides a new solution for process digitalization and continues the industry trend of AI tools extending from personal assistants to enterprise-level collaboration scenarios.
